paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary has been recognized at the highest levels of academic excellence in China, as the 'Hundred People Project' is a competitive program designed to identify and nurture top-tier scholars who can contribute significantly to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The rigorous selection process for such programs typically involves comprehensive evaluation of academic achievements, research impact, and future potential, ensuring that only the most distinguished scholars receive this honor [Exhibit A1, p.2]. While specific selection numbers are not provided in the source materials, talent programs of this nature are inherently selective, with only a small percentage of eligible scholars receiving such recognition, placing the Beneficiary among an elite group of academics in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2, p.4]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education, which established an Award Committee composed of the director and deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, convenors of each department, and heads of relevant departments, bureaus, and units [Exhibit B10, p.5]. The selection occurs every three years and follows a rigorous evaluation process where an evaluation committee of experts and scholars with high academic attainments from across the country conducts centralized independent evaluation based on strict criteria including theoretical achievements, academic innovation, and significant economic and social benefits [Exhibit B10, p.4, p.5, p.6]. The award structure includes grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, with the Beneficiary's third prize representing recognition among the top tier of submissions in a national competition that evaluates books, dissertations, research reports, and popularization achievements from higher education institutions across China [Exhibit B10, p.5, p.6]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Legacy of the Year Award at the 2019 Data Awards, which are pronounced the same as 'beacon' in Chinese and represent one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.2, p.3]. These awards were jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation, with a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process involved a two-month review period using professional selection models, resulting in only 28 Data individuals standing out from what was presumably a much larger pool of candidates in the mobile Internet and big data fields [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who have worked deeply in big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading insights and experiences to educate the whole industry, with recipients described as leaders who guide many Internet practitioners and always guide the development of the industry [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was issued by the Communication Association of China and the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, indicating recognition at a major national communication conference in China [Exhibit B11, p.2]. While specific selection criteria and competition numbers are not provided in the source materials, awards at national conferences of this scale typically involve peer review of numerous submissions, with only the most outstanding papers receiving recognition [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The certificate was issued on July 10, 2010, demonstrating that the Beneficiary's work has been recognized as excellent in the field of communication for over a decade [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary's recognition extends beyond academic awards to include industry accolades such as being associated with Enterprise Service High-growth Company 36 Kr and China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice Three Major Fields, as evidenced in Umeng+'s award listings [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These industry recognitions demonstrate that the Beneficiary's work has impact beyond academia, with Umeng+ itself having received numerous prestigious certifications including ISO/IEC 27001:2013 Information Security Management System Certification and ISO/IEC 27018:2019 Public Cloud Personal Information Protection Management System Certification, becoming the first batch of big data services providers in China with high-standard Public Cloud Personal Information Protection Certification [Exhibit B4, p.3]. The breadth of these recognitions—spanning enterprise service, big data industry applications, and data technology innovation—shows that the Beneficiary's expertise is valued across multiple sectors of the technology and data industries [Exhibit B4, p.4]. This cross-sector recognition further establishes the Beneficiary as a leader whose contributions are acknowledged not only in academic circles but also in practical industry applications and enterprise contexts [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
